e5_top10.raw_text: Create a token that's a copy of target creature you control.
e5_top10.plain_text: Create a token that is a copy of a creature you already control.

e5_top10.raw_text: {2}, {T}: Choose a color. Add an amount of mana of that color equal to your devotion to that color. (Your devotion to a color is the number of mana symbols of that color in the mana costs of permanents you control.)
e5_top10.plain_text: Pay two generic mana and tap this permanent to produce a large burst of mana in a single color, as much as your devotion to that color.

e5_top10.raw_text: Lands you control have "{T}: Add one mana of any color."
e5_top10.plain_text: Every land you control gains the ability to tap for one mana of any color.

e5_top10.raw_text: Exalted (Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, that creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.)
e5_top10.plain_text: This creature has exalted, so whenever a creature you control attacks by itself, that creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.

e5_top10.raw_text: If you tap a permanent for mana, it produces twice as much of that mana instead.
e5_top10.plain_text: Whenever you tap a permanent for mana, it produces double the mana instead.

e5_top10.raw_text: This spell costs {1} less to cast for each creature on the battlefield.
e5_top10.plain_text: This spell costs one less generic mana to cast for each creature on the battlefield, so it gets cheaper as the board fills up.

e5_top10.raw_text: {T}: Add one mana of any color.
e5_top10.plain_text: Tap this permanent to produce one mana of whatever color you need.

e5_top10.raw_text: You may have this creature enter as a copy of a creature or planeswalker you control, except it enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it if it's a creature, it enters with an additional loyalty counter on it if it's a planeswalker, and it isn't legendary.
e5_top10.plain_text: This creature can enter the battlefield as a copy of a creature or planeswalker you already control, arriving with one extra counter on it and never legendary.

e5_top10.raw_text: As an additional cost to cast this spell, pay X life.
e5_top10.plain_text: Pay any amount of life as an extra cost when you cast this spell.

e5_top10.raw_text: You may have this creature enter as a copy of a creature you control.
e5_top10.plain_text: This creature can enter the battlefield as a copy of a creature you already control.
